frozen: 2026-10-30, before any result of this search; after the e54/e55/e55b screens recorded in reports/PHYSICS_GAPS_20261030.md
why: With the pressure-gated monsoon westerlies (e55b: monsoon_westerly 1.0, monsoon_pressure_hpa 2.0) North India's rain rises 256 -> 441 mm with little collateral damage (31-region S 0.9962), but North India's temperature worsens (+0.24 C, the wetter monsoon cools the plain while its dry season stays 3-5 C too cold) and the training group worsens (S 1.005). Dry-ground heating (e54b) fixed North India's dry season but overheated the too-dry monsoon; with a wet monsoon the two should combine. The rain efficiency and the monsoon descent were fitted around the old winds. These six settings are searched together; everything else stays r39.
score: scripts/gate_calibrate.py: S as scripts/gate_local.py over dev31 against the r39 run, plus 2 x every group's worsening and 2 x any T or P worsening beyond 1 %
selection: the lowest-cost completed candidate; ties broken by S
validation: the selected candidate is rerun as a fresh benchmark_local dev31 run and judged by scripts/gate_local.py against the r39 run (policy v2); then the paired 28 km check (california, western_europe, japan, new_zealand: S not worse by more than 1 %); then the sealed six of regions_sealed6.json once against output/physics_gaps_20261030/r39_sealed6. Failing any step means nothing is adopted; every result is reported.
